disclaimer: Numbers verified on the official pages listed on the date above. Re-check before each release; call your own vet first when you can.

poisonCentres.name: ASPCA Animal Poison Control Center
poisonCentres.fee: A consultation fee may apply (amount not stated on the official page on the checked date).
poisonCentres.quote: We are available 24/7, 365 days a year.

poisonCentres.name: Pet Poison Helpline
poisonCentres.fee: USD 99 per incident, follow-up consultations included.
poisonCentres.quote: There is a one-time consultation fee of $99 per incident.
poisonCentres.note: An older number (800) 213-6680 still appears on some PPH pages — not used.

poisonCentres.name: CNITV – Centre National d'Informations Toxicologiques Vétérinaires (VetAgro Sup, Lyon)
poisonCentres.fee: No per-call fee stated; funded by vets' memberships and donations (vets and private individuals).
poisonCentres.quote: Pour toute urgence, appelez notre ligne d'assistance au 04 78 87 10 40
poisonCentres.note: Closed from midnight to 08:30 — the app must show this and route to an on-duty vet at night.

poisonCentres.name: CAPAE-Ouest – Centre Anti-Poison Animal et Environnemental de l'Ouest (Oniris, Nantes)
poisonCentres.fee: Not stated on the official page.
poisonCentres.audience: principalement les vétérinaires, également contacté par les propriétaires d'animaux
poisonCentres.quote: Le Centre répond de 8h30 à minuit, 365 jours/an

otherFrenchVetPoisonCentres: None found. Official CNITV and Oniris pages name no other French veterinary poison centre; human poison centres (CAP) are for people.

onDutyVetFrance.name: Votre vétérinaire habituel (service de garde / permanence des soins)
onDutyVetFrance.howTo: Call your usual practice: French vets must tell the public how their out-of-hours emergency cover works (e.g. exterior notice at the practice; the phone line usually redirects to the on-duty vet).
onDutyVetFrance.quote: permettre à tout détenteur d'un animal de pouvoir lui faire prodiguer des soins urgents
onDutyVetFrance.note: Redirection via answering machine is described in Ordre service-de-garde templates (seen via search, not on this page).

onDutyVetFrance.name: 3115 – régulation vétérinaire
onDutyVetFrance.quote: Un Vétérinaire régulateur répond à vos Urgences
onDutyVetFrance.whatIsVerified: The 3115.fr site exists and presents a veterinary triage ("régulateur") service for dogs, cats, rabbits, guinea pigs, ferrets, chinchillas and rodents.
onDutyVetFrance.notVerified: Operator, call cost, hours and geographic coverage are NOT stated on the official page. Third-party sites say it is free, 24/7, run by the private Emergence network and covers ~45 départements — unconfirmed; one local site stresses it is a private commercial line, not a public service. Not stated for birds.
